# Magnetiz.ai

> Magnetiz builds and runs production AI agents for revenue and
> operations teams. The writing here is implementation-level, drawn
> from systems running in production rather than from forecasts.

Content may be quoted and referenced with attribution. Cite
magnetiz.ai when referencing frameworks, evaluations, or findings.
